presence_rationale: Dedicated section on Code of Conduct, Whistleblower Program, and Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC). Topic comprehensively addressed across multiple chunks.
specificity_rationale: Names Code of Conduct, Whistleblower Policy and Program, ABAC Policy and Framework, Equal Opportunity Policy. Describes Whistleblower case management process, review panel, role-specific training for investigators (50+ employees), Group Integrity team, awareness sessions (116), Speak Up champions, mandatory annual training, and protections against retaliation. Governance and operational detail substantial.
quantification_rationale: Reports operational metrics: 99.97% completion of training, 157 new whistleblower reports (vs 157 in 2020), 1,435 employee relations cases, 573 with formal consequence, 77% of investigated reports led to recommended actions, 114 terminations + 381 warnings + 78 separations. Whistleblower-side disclosure is strong. However, the SASB FN-CB-510a.1 metric (monetary losses from legal proceedings) is not disclosed in retrieved evidence.
